module TokenValidator where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Int (Int32)
import Data.Bits (shiftL, shiftR, (.&.), (.|.))
import System.IO (hSetBuffering, BufferMode(..), stdout)
import Network.Socket
import Network.Socket.ByteString (recv, sendAll)
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless)
import Control.Exception (bracket, catch, SomeException)
import Data.IORef

-- Token validation service for internal microservice auth
-- Tokens are 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 values stored in a token table

type TokenTable = ByteString  -- concatenated 32-byte tokens

-- Secret keys stored after the token table in memory
secretSuffix :: ByteString
secretSuffix = BC.pack "MASTER_KEY_2024_PRODUCTION_HMAC_SECRET_DO_NOT_LEAK_EVER"

tokenTableRef :: IORef TokenTable
tokenTableRef = undefined  -- initialized at startup
{-# NOINLINE tokenTableRef #-}

tokenSize :: Int
tokenSize = 32

maxTokens :: Int
maxTokens = 256

-- Parse a 4-byte big-endian offset from the request
-- The offset indicates which token slot to validate against
parseOffset :: ByteString -> Int32
parseOffset bs
  | BS.length bs < 4 = 0
  | otherwise = 
      let b0 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 0) :: Int32
          b1 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 1) :: Int32
          b2 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 2) :: Int32
          b3 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 3) :: Int32
      in (b0 `shiftL` 24) .|. (b1 `shiftL` 16) .|. (b2 `shiftL` 8) .|. b3

-- Validate that the requested slot index is within bounds
-- Returns True if the index is safe to use
boundsCheck :: Int -> Int -> Bool
boundsCheck tableLen idx = idx < tableLen
{-# INLINE boundsCheck #-}

-- Extract a token from the table at the given slot
extractToken :: TokenTable -> Int -> ByteString
extractToken table slotIdx = 
  let byteOffset = slotIdx * tokenSize
  in BS.take tokenSize (BS.drop byteOffset table)

-- Compare two tokens in constant time
constantTimeEq :: ByteString -> ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeEq a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = BS.foldl' (.|.) 0 (BS.pack $ BS.zipWith (\x y -> x `xor'` y) a b) == 0
  where xor' x y = x `xor''` y
        xor'' :: Word8 -> Word8 -> Word8
        xor'' a' b' = fromIntegral $ (fromIntegral a' :: Int) `xor'''` (fromIntegral b' :: Int)
        xor'''  = \x y -> (x + y) - 2 * (x .&. y)  -- XOR via arithmetic

-- Process a validation request
-- Request format: [4 bytes: slot index (big-endian signed)] [32 bytes: token to validate]
processRequest :: TokenTable -> ByteString -> ByteString
processRequest table request
  | BS.length request < 36 = BC.pack "ERR:SHORT_REQUEST"
  | otherwise =
      let slotOffset = parseOffset request  -- Int32, can be negative!
          slotIdx = fromIntegral slotOffset :: Int  -- sign-extended to Int
          tokenData = BS.take tokenSize (BS.drop 4 request)
          numSlots = BS.length table `div` tokenSize
      in if boundsCheck numSlots slotIdx
         then let storedToken = extractToken table slotIdx
              in if constantTimeEq storedToken tokenData
                 then BC.pack "OK:VALID"
                 else BC.pack "ERR:INVALID_TOKEN"
         else BC.pack "ERR:SLOT_OUT_OF_RANGE"

-- Handle a client connection
handleClient :: Socket -> IO ()
handleClient sock = do
  table <- readIORef tokenTableRef
  request <- recv sock 1024
  unless (BS.null request) $ do
    let response = processRequest table request
    sendAll sock response

-- Main server loop
startServer :: Int -> IO ()
startServer port = do
  hSetBuffering stdout LineBuffering
  -- Initialize token table with test tokens
  let initialTable = BS.replicate (maxTokens * tokenSize) 0
  writeIORef tokenTableRef (initialTable `BS.append` secretSuffix)
  addr <- resolve (show port)
  bracket (open addr) close loop
  where
    resolve p = do
      let hints = defaultHints { addrFlags = [AI_PASSIVE], addrSocketType = Stream }
      head <$> getAddrInfo (Just hints) Nothing (Just p)
    open addr = do
      sock <- socket (addrFamily addr) (addrSocketType addr) (addrProtocol addr)
      setSocketOption sock ReuseAddr 1
      bind sock (addrAddress addr)
      listen sock 10
      return sock
    loop sock = forever $ do
      (conn, _) <- accept sock
      handleClient conn `catch` (\(_ :: SomeException) -> return ())
      close conn
